# Pico PM2.5 Display v1.0.0

- Target: Raspberry Pi Pico / RP2040
- Display: Waveshare Pico-LCD-1.3
- Sensor: PMS7003 auto-detected on UART1 (GP4/GP5, current wiring) or UART0 (GP0/GP1)
- Pico SDK: 2.3.1
- Firmware: `pico-pm25-v1.0.0.uf2`
- SHA-256: `422B26FA1EA0BD6F0266344E446D2B032360B17D58A0E11EEF047A0E6AA140B3`

Hold BOOTSEL while connecting the Pico, then copy the UF2 to the `RPI-RP2`
drive. The board reboots automatically after the copy finishes.
